name: strikeglass
description: Strikeglass is a responsive local-first Neverwinter combat-log analyzer with independently checked combat results, explicit evidence states, direct evidence coverage, player-friendly metric semantics, verified team-debuff intelligence, player comparison, power damage, progressive loading, raw-hit traceability, trust mapping, attempt consistency, fight fingerprints, moment inspection, and longitudinal analysis.
author: Nischhal Raj Subba

scripts.test:browser: node scripts/browser-smoke.mjs && node scripts/privacy-egress-regression.mjs --root public && node scripts/browser-performance-budget.mjs --root public
scripts.build: pnpm test && pnpm vendor:charts && node build-static.mjs && node scripts/artifact-regression.mjs
